title: Pure Duel Dragon
summary: Pure Duel Dragon Synchro strategy inspired by the Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's manga, centered on the ancient creator dragons Ultimaya Tzolkin and Crimson Dragon. By using a specialized Resonator engine to assemble equal-Level Tuners and non-Tuners, the deck sends Coral Dragon and Stardust Charge Warrior to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin, triggering it with Scrap-Iron Statue to cheat out Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon and Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Soul Resonator on Normal or Special Summon searches Bone Archfiend from Deck to hand, protecting your cards in the GY from destruction.
Bone Archfiend sends a card from hand or field to GY to Special Summon itself, then dumps Vision Resonator from Deck to modulate its Level to 4.
Vision Resonator Special Summons itself while you control a Level 5 or higher DARK monster, and searches Crimson Gaia when sent to the GY.
Crimson Gaia searches Soul Resonator or Vision Resonator every turn, ensuring non-stop Synchro follow-up.

summary.title: Opening: Soul Resonator
steps: Normal Summon Soul Resonator and activate its effect to search Bone Archfiend from your Deck.
Activate Bone Archfiend, sending a card from hand to GY to Special Summon itself; activate its second effect to send Vision Resonator from Deck to GY and reduce its Level to 4.
Trigger Vision Resonator in GY to search Crimson Gaia, then activate Crimson Gaia to search another Resonator.
Synchro Summon Coral Dragon (Level 6 Tuner) and Stardust Charge Warrior (Level 6 non-Tuner), drawing 1 card from Charge Warrior.
Send Level 6 Tuner Coral Dragon and Level 6 non-Tuner Stardust Charge Warrior from field to GY to Special Summon Ultimaya Tzolkin from the Extra Deck.
Set Scrap-Iron Statue face-down, immediately triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin to cheat out Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon (or Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons) directly from your Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ultimaya Tzolkin cannot be targeted for attacks or card effects while you control another Synchro Monster, and Special Summons a Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro or Power Tool Synchro from your Extra Deck whenever a Spell/Trap is Set on your field.
Crimson Dragon is a Level 12 Synchro that searches Synchro Rumble on summon and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect to summon a Dragon Synchro matching a targeted Synchro's Level.
Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon negates an opponent monster's activated effect once per turn, destroys it, and gains ATK equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK.
Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, and gains ATK equal to any damage you take or that it takes in battle.
Stardust Spark Dragon targets 1 face-up card you control (including Ultimaya Tzolkin) once per turn as a Quick Effect to make it indestructible by battle or card effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Scrap-Iron Statue negates an opponent's face-up Spell or Trap card and Sets itself back face-down instead of going to the GY, continuously re-triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin on both players' turns.
Synchro Rumble revives a Tuner or Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro from your GY and protects your Synchro Monsters from battle destruction.
Power Tool Braver Dragon equips Metalsilver Armor and Life Extreme from your Deck on summon, forcing all opponent targeting onto Braver and altering battle stats.

allow.Soul Resonator: Level 3 Tuner that searches Bone Archfiend on Normal/Special Summon to assemble Level 6 Synchros and Level 12 Crimson Dragon.
allow.Bone Archfiend: Special Summons itself from hand or GY and dumps a Resonator to adjust Levels for Level 6 Synchros (for Ultimaya Tzolkin) or Level 12 Crimson Dragon.
allow.Vision Resonator: Level 2 Tuner that Special Summons itself and searches Crimson Gaia when sent to the GY.
allow.Crimson Gaia: Continuous Spell that searches Soul Resonator or Vision Resonator every turn.
allow.Synchro Rumble: Spell searchable by Crimson Dragon that revives a Tuner or Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro from the GY.
allow.Metalsilver Armor: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that prevents the opponent from targeting any monster except the equipped one.
allow.Life Extreme: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that boosts ATK by 1500 and destroys a card when battle positions change.
allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 Synchro Tuner made with Level 2 Vision Resonator + Level 4 Bone Archfiend; serves as the exact Level 5+ Tuner required to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin!
allow.Stardust Charge Warrior: Level 6 non-Tuner Synchro made with Level 2 Vision Resonator + Level 4 Bone Archfiend that draws 1 card and pairs with Coral Dragon to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin!

Searches Soul Resonator or Vision Resonator during your Main Phase so you can summon Ultimaya Tzolkin or Crimson Dragon every turn.
Searched by Crimson Dragon on Synchro Summon; revives a Tuner or a Level 7/8 Dragon Duel Dragon from your GY.
Set to trigger Ultimaya Tzolkin, negates an opponent's face-up Spell/Trap activation, and sets itself back face-down instead of going to the GY (re-triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin every turn!).

Level 12 Synchro that searches Synchro Rumble and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect to Synchro Summon any Dragon Synchro matching a targeted Synchro's Level.
Level 8 Dragon Synchro summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that negates any monster effect once per turn and gains ATK.
Signature Level 8 DARK Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and gains ATK whenever you take damage.
Signature Level 8 LIGHT Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that makes 1 face-up card you control (including Tzolkin!) immune to battle and card effect destruction once per turn.
Signature Level 7 LIGHT Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that bounces a Special Summoned monster the opponent controls.
Level 9 Power Tool Synchro summoned via Ultimaya Tzolkin that equips up to 3 Equip Spells from Deck/GY and sends 1 Equip to negate a monster's effect or change its battle position.
Signature Level 8 DARK Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that destroys all other face-up Attack Position monsters on the field.
